universe: All root records in the ashtadhyayi.com Dhātupāṭha dataset; gaṇasūtra rows and roots without an English gloss are excluded.
selection_note: Complete Dhātupāṭha root corpus: 2228 roots from 2229 root records. The 30 gaṇasūtra rows are sūtra records, not roots. Roots without an English gloss are excluded (09.0029). The original 210 common roots retain their core/additional/extended tiers; all other roots use the outside_common tier.

ganasutra.reason: Gaṇasūtra records are sūtras within the Dhātupāṭha, not dhātus.

missing_english.reason: No artha_english value is supplied by the primary dataset.

01.1114.note: The primary record reads gatireṣaṇayoḥ; Vidyut reads gatiroṣaṇayoḥ. The primary meaning is retained and the Vidyut crosscheck is flagged_uncertain.
